title.en: Which pump prints a 5 m tight-site window?
title.zh: 哪一台泵印了 5 米的狭小场地窗口？

description.en: B500S-83D: 7.5 kW, 380 V, 5 m height, 5 m horizontal, sand and small stone 5–16 mm, 280 kg. The short boom is not a truck boom.
description.zh: B500S-83D：7.5 kW、380 V、垂直 5 m、水平 5 m、砂与小石 5–16 mm、280 kg。短臂架不是车载布料杆。

h1.en: Which pump prints a 5 m tight-site window?
h1.zh: 哪一台泵印了 5 米的狭小场地窗口？

directAnswer.en: B500S-83D. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists this two-stage manual/electric pump for short-reach sand and small stone: 7.5 kW, 380 V, delivery height 5 m, horizontal 5 m, materials 5–16 mm, standard hose, 915 × 550 × 550 mm and 280 kg. The short boom is part of the compact unit, not a truck-mounted placing boom. The selection guide puts it first for a 5 m small site.
directAnswer.zh: B500S-83D。邢台河北品锦机械把这台两级手动/电动泵列为短距离砂与小石：7.5 kW、380 V、垂直 5 m、水平 5 m、材料 5–16 mm、标准胶管、外形 915 × 550 × 550 mm、280 kg。短臂架属于本机，不是车载布料杆。选型指南把 5 m 的小型工地放在它前面。

body.en: Height and horizontal distance are each 5 m. Electric 15 prints 15–20 m vertical and 60–80 m horizontal at 450 kg. If the pipe is longer than 5 m, B500S-83D is no longer the row, even if the site feels tight. Stone outside 5–16 mm also leaves this page.
body.zh: 高度和水平都是 5 m。电动15印的是垂直 15–20 m、水平 60–80 m、450 kg。管路长于 5 m 时，即使场地显得狭小，也不再是 B500S-83D。石子超出 5–16 mm 同样离开这一页。

body.en: There is no diesel B500S page. A tight site without 380 V looks at the 17 kW rural diesel or the tractor-driven 4100, which are larger and print longer distances. Do not describe B500S-83D as the off-grid compact pump.
body.zh: 没有柴油版 B500S 页面。没有 380 V 的狭小工地去看 17 kW 农村柴油泵或拖拉机带动4100，那两台更大，距离也更长。不要把 B500S-83D 写成无电网紧凑泵。

heading.en: What should Xingtai receive with the inquiry?
heading.zh: 向邢台询盘要带上什么？

body.en: Confirm 380 V, 5 m / 5 m, and 5–16 mm stone. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print.
body.zh: 请确认 380 V、5 m / 5 m，以及 5–16 mm 石子。 请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。

question.en: Is the boom a truck boom?

answer.en: No. The catalogue says the short boom belongs to this compact unit.
answer.zh: 不是。目录写明短臂架属于这台紧凑机。

answer.en: No. That sentence is on Electric 15, Electric 10 Series, the rural diesel and the 4100.
answer.zh: 没有。那句话在电动15、电动10系列、农村柴油泵和 4100 上。

question.en: Is 280 kg the lightest listed pump?
question.zh: 280 kg 是列出的最轻泵吗？

answer.en: It is the lightest pump weight cited on the selection-guide small-site question. Sprayers such as Type 311 print 150 kg and are not pumps.
answer.zh: 它是选型指南小型工地问题里引用的最轻泵重。311 等喷涂机印了 150 kg，但它们不是泵。
